annotations.title: Do our post's views look real?

description: Authenticity score (0-100) for the brand's OWN posts: the same score Hermoso gives creator-campaign posts, from the readings the platform reported. Higher means the views look like real people watching; every point taken off names its reason (engagement far below views, views that jumped between readings with no new engagement, a view count that went down, comments with no likes), and `confidence` (0-1) says how much it rests on. Pass postId for one post, or omit it to list the brand's scored posts lowest first (minScore / maxScore to find the ones that look inflated). A platform that shares no views (Facebook) and YouTube (its API policy) get no score, with the reason. Never removes or flags a post anywhere. Read-only, 0 credits.

brand.description: profile id/name from list_brands, this call only

postId.description: one post: record id, platform post id or link; omit to list
